notes: PUMS is a sample of person records; weighted cell counts estimate population counts with sampling error that is not computed here (no replicate weights).
Missing values in grouping columns are kept as their own cell; their meaning is the variable's universe in the PUMS data dictionary.
Kept 462 of 462 person record(s) inside AGEP in [19, 64], POVPIP in [0, 137].
Coarsened AGEP into 3 band(s), labelled by lower edge, ESR into 5 band(s), labelled by lower edge.
Aggregated to 16 cell(s) from 462 person record(s); 17 cell(s) with fewer than 10 records were withheld (69 record(s), weighted 6,289). No person-level row is returned.
